<title level="1" right="Deity " pfs="Standard">[Ydersius](/Deities.aspx?ID=323)</title>

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

<traits>

</traits>

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 302

The [serpentfolk](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=468) deity Ydersius was defeated by an Azlanti heroine named Savith in the era before Earthfall, and now the so-called Headless King’s body prowls aimlessly in [the Darklands](/Rules.aspx?ID=2993). Reduced to a feral, animalistic existence, Ydersius is unaware of his great legacy and former dominion. Ydersius’s symbol is a snake’s skull surrounded by a skeletal ouroboros.

<column gap="tiny">

**Category** [Other Gods](/DeityCategories.aspx?ID=2)

**Edicts** seek to return Ydersius to life, fulfill your passions, conquer your foes with no mercy, achieve glory for serpentkind

**Anathema** put the needs of others above those of serpentfolk, aid the spawn of Azlant
